changes: Enable glGetError; disable magic colour discard and unused multithread hints.
Replace signed shifts of negative values/sign bit in compatibility test and edge slopes.
Zero-initialize ZBuffer raster state; resizing adapter preserves non-storage state.
glGenBuffers uses caller output for reserved names, retaining the 4096-byte SDK stack-frame limit.
Evaluate ERROR_FLAG in C: preprocessor comparisons of enum names incorrectly converted every error into GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY. Preserve the first pending error.
Opt-in caller-owned contexts and scalar compatibility triangle callbacks; native default unchanged.
Bound glDeleteLists to the requested range.
Correct packed-pixel enum values, interpolate both compatibility texture coordinates through clipping, route opt-in points/lines to scalar fragments, preserve homogeneous W.
Initialization OOM returns GL_OUT_OF_MEMORY and permits partial cleanup; native runtime compatibility test retained.
Optional Win32 texgen vertex hook and full eye-coordinate interpolation for user clipping; native callbacks remain unset.
Preserve the original software primitive provoking color before quad splitting and homogeneous clipping; native rendering unchanged.
